title: A Garden for the Songbook
author: Vesper Delacroix
blurb: Theo Pemberton, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, has spent three years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
